import pytest

from typesystem.base import ParseError
from typesystem.tokenize.tokens import DictToken, ListToken, ScalarToken
from typesystem.tokenize.tokenize_json import tokenize_json


def test_tokenize_json_object():
    token = tokenize_json('{"a": 1}')
    assert isinstance(token, DictToken)
    assert token.value == {"a": 1}
    # Token spans the full string: start at '{', end at '}'
    assert token.start == 0
    assert token.end == 7


def test_tokenize_json_array():
    token = tokenize_json("[1, 2, 3]")
    assert isinstance(token, ListToken)
    assert token.value == [1, 2, 3]


def test_tokenize_json_scalar_string():
    token = tokenize_json('"hello"')
    assert isinstance(token, ScalarToken)
    assert token.value == "hello"


def test_tokenize_json_scalar_keywords_and_numbers():
    assert tokenize_json("null").value is None
    assert tokenize_json("true").value is True
    assert tokenize_json("false").value is False
    assert tokenize_json("42").value == 42
    assert tokenize_json("-1.5e3").value == -1500.0


def test_tokenize_json_bytes_input():
    token = tokenize_json(b'{"key": "value"}')
    assert token.value == {"key": "value"}


def test_tokenize_json_nested():
    token = tokenize_json('{"outer": {"inner": [1, "two", null]}}')
    assert token.value == {"outer": {"inner": [1, "two", None]}}


def test_tokenize_json_key_positions():
    token = tokenize_json('{"a": 1}')
    key_token = token._value["a"]  # dict maps key-token -> value-token
    # Key token covers the quoted string, index 1 through 3
    assert token._value["a"].start == 5
    assert token._value["a"].end == 5


def test_tokenize_json_empty_string_raises():
    with pytest.raises(ParseError) as exc:
        tokenize_json("")
    assert exc.value.code == "no_content"
    assert exc.value.text == "No content."
    assert exc.value.position.line_no == 1
    assert exc.value.position.column_no == 1


def test_tokenize_json_whitespace_only_raises():
    with pytest.raises(ParseError) as exc:
        tokenize_json("   \n\t ")
    assert exc.value.code == "no_content"


def test_tokenize_json_malformed_raises_with_position():
